terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: Not solved with solve_camera_pose.py (multi-object composite, no single rigid subject to fit camera to). Approximated from the reference's near-eye-level, slight-downward framing. Confirm by overlay review during blockout.

objectClass.primaryType: held-smartphone-with-AR-shopping-UI, plus floating handbag callout, on a blurred retail backdrop
motionPotential: hand: static grip pose, no rig
objectClass.notes: Composite marketing image, not a single-object photo (see analysis.md). Scoped per explicit user instruction into 4 real geometric macro objects (phone, hand, bag, price-tag) sharing one root group, plus one explicitly non-geometric backdrop approximation built outside this spec's componentTree.

reasoning: 4 independent macro objects (phone, hand, bag, price-tag) each with their own meso sub-parts.
occlusionRisk elevated: hand occludes phone's right edge/back; bag/tag backs never shown -- single-view inference for all four.
repetitionSystems=1: hand's three curling fingers (index/middle/ring) authored as one parameterized repetition group, not four bespoke meshes.

Backdrop and the two flat UI-content layers (screen card stack, location-list card) are intentionally excluded from componentTree -- textures/backdrop per the suitability verdict, not sculpted geometry.

specDepthDecision.rationale: 4 macro objects with real meso sub-parts, one bounded repetition system (fingers), and materials with local overrides (skin knuckle sheen, screen emissive region, badge accent) place this at the complex tier -- not ultra-complex, since no single object here carries CS2-grade micro-detail density.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation: Phone back shell and right-edge button layout (occluded by hand/angle) -- approximated as a plain slab back, flagged as inference.
Hand's dorsal (back) side and exact finger joint angles -- approximated with a generic curl pose, not measured.
Handbag hardware (clasp/zipper/stitching) -- below legible resolution, approximated as unadorned matte body.
Mall backdrop identity/architecture -- explicitly NOT reconstructed as 3D geometry; approximated as a soft blurred backdrop plane.

anatomy.note: Hand only, no head/face/torso in frame -- this is a partial-figure (hand+forearm-stub) reconstruction, not a full character build. anatomy fields beyond pose/features are not applicable.

definitionOfDone: The rendered scene matches the reference's four-object composition (phone-in-hand, handbag+tag), their relative placement, silhouettes, proportions, hold angle, and local color palette.
Screen content is a projected/baked crop of the reference's own UI pixels, not a procedural re-creation of the app design.
Backdrop reads as a soft out-of-focus retail space without claiming architectural accuracy.

antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a complex scene.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap.
Do not claim the mall backdrop is reconstructed 3D architecture -- it is an explicit non-geometric approximation.

mustMatch: screen carries projected reference UI content
niceToHave: secondary rim lighting matching the reference's soft top-light

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision inspects a side-by-side reference/render sheet and scores the current pass 0-1. Pixel-diff assists diagnostics but does not approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Score the 5 featureGroups above; group repeated fingers instead of scoring each individually.

stopCriteria: target fidelity reached or user accepts current approximation
remaining gaps require new reference images (phone back, hand back, bag back) or manual art

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the reference frame against the front render; three-quarter/top-down renders are self-consistency checks only (no reference angle exists for them).
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

sculptPipeline.blockedReason: blockout requires a browser screenshot and self-correction review before structural-pass unlocks
nextRequiredEvidence: AI vision score >= 0.7 with layer scores
critical feature scores meeting their thresholds
reviewHistory entry for blockout with action=continue

assumptions: Phone modeled as a generic modern slab smartphone (no brand-specific button/port layout claimed) since back/edges are occluded.
Hand pose approximated as a generic right-hand phone grip; exact joint angles are inference, not measurement.
Handbag hardware omitted (unadorned matte body) -- below legible resolution in the source.
Mall backdrop is an explicit non-geometric approximation (blurred backdrop plane), not reconstructed architecture.
Screen UI content and the floating location-list card are reproduced via a projected/baked crop of the reference's own pixels, de-lit, not redrawn procedurally.
risks: Single-view reconstruction: no back/side reference exists for phone, hand, or bag -- non-frontal turntable angles are self-consistency checks only, not reference-verified.
Backdrop fidelity is capped by design (soft blur approximation); it will not read as an accurate depiction of a specific mall.

coordinateFrame.front: camera-facing side in the reference image
coordinateFrame.scaleReference: unit = 1 real-world meter; phone height ~0.15 units, adjust after first browser render

silhouette.boundingShape: wide landscape group: bag (upper-left) + phone-in-hand (center, tall) + price-tag (overlapping bag) within a ~1.38:1 frame
silhouette.symmetry: asymmetric composition; phone itself bilaterally symmetric about its long axis (broken by notch), bag bilaterally symmetric about its vertical centerline
dominantCurves: fingers' curl arcs over phone edge
negativeSpaces: gap between bag's handle loop and its body
gap between hand's curled fingers and palm (open grip pocket)
landmarks: fingertip contact row along phone's top-left edge

observations: Four-object marketing composite: floating handbag+tag (upper-left), floating location-list UI card (upper-right, excluded from geometry), phone-in-hand (center), blurred mall backdrop (full frame, behind).
Slab phone body, ~15-20deg tilt, front-camera notch top-center, cover glass showing app UI, held screen-toward-viewer.
Right hand, four fingers curling over phone's top-left edge (fingertip pads visible on front face left margin), thumb near bottom-left of screen, forearm exits frame bottom-right.
Trapezoidal tote body tapering toward top, semicircular top handle, own drop shadow; white price-tag chip '$145' with red '-24%' corner badge overlapping bag's lower body.
Deep-blurred mall interior: glossy floor reflections, storefront glass both sides, two silhouetted figures, ceiling light strip. Explicit non-geometric approximation target.

componentTree.name: Capture Service AR Scene
componentTree.topologyRationale: Pure organizational pivot; no geometry of its own.

collider.notes: no collider needed on scene root

componentTree.name: Phone body shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Manufactured slab product; hard-surface rounded-rect extrusion, not an organic blend.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: rounded-rect slab, large corner radius (~14% short edge), thin depth
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: vertex normals with per-face flat shading on body, smooth on rounded edges

seams: phone-screen seam at front face inset

surfaceDetail.normalPattern: brushed-metal micro-anisotropy on edge band only
surfaceDetail.notes: Back shell face and right-edge buttons are occluded/inferred -- flat plain slab used there.

componentTree.name: Phone screen (cover glass + emissive UI)
componentTree.topologyRationale: Flat inset panel bounded by the body's front-face bezel.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: thin inset plane, slightly recessed from body front face
geometryDescriptor.uvStrategy: planar UVs matched 1:1 to projected screen-crop texture

localFeatures: bottom nav sheet: 'ZARA 16m to go' bar with close (X) button

surfaceDetail.notes: Emissive content layer is a de-lit projected crop of the reference's own screen region, baked into the screen UV -- not a procedurally redrawn UI.

componentTree.name: Front-camera notch
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small hard-surface capsule cutout at top bezel.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: small flattened capsule, embedded at top-center bezel

componentTree.name: Gripping hand
componentTree.topologyRationale: Organic, continuous-surface anatomy; not decomposable into hard-surface primitives without reading as blocky.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: stylized low-to-mid-poly hand: palm mass + 4 finger tubes + thumb + forearm capsule stub
deformationStack: finger curl bend per repetition instance

surfaceDetail.occlusionPattern: AO between curled fingers and palm
surfaceDetail.notes: Back/dorsal side of hand never shown -- generic anatomical inference used there.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: flattened ellipsoid mass behind the phone's left edge
tapered capsule, two-segment bend toward screen bottom-left

componentTree.name: Curling fingers (index/middle/ring)
componentTree.topologyRationale: Repeated tapered tube family, bent uniformly over the phone edge.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: 3x tapered two-segment capsule fingers curling over the phone's top-left edge
deformationStack: per-instance curl bend, angle varies by repetition index

localFeatures: fingertip contact row visible along phone top-left edge

surfaceDetail.occlusionPattern: AO where fingers overlap phone edge

componentTree.name: Forearm stub
componentTree.topologyRationale: Simple tapered cylinder, exits frame so full form is not needed.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: short tapered cylinder exiting toward camera-bottom-right, cut off (not capped visibly)

surfaceDetail.notes: Cut off out-of-frame in reference; length here is a stylistic choice, not measured.

componentTree.name: Handbag
componentTree.topologyRationale: Structured/rigid bag, hard-surface panel construction, not soft cloth drape.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: trapezoidal prism body tapering toward top opening, sharp bottom corners
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: flat per face with soft corner bevel

localFeatures: small dark D-ring hardware at strap attachment, lower-left of main handle (zone-r0c0)

surfaceDetail.occlusionPattern: AO at base corners and gusset fold
surfaceDetail.notes: Clasp/zipper/stitching below legible resolution -- omitted. One small dark hardware ring IS legible (zone-r0c0) and is included as a localFeature.

componentTree.name: Handle loop
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin swept-tube arc; classic curve+tube case, not a solid mass.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: semicircular tube arc spanning the bag's top opening

surfaceDetail.occlusionPattern: contact AO where loop meets body

componentTree.name: Price tag ($145 / -24%)

geometryDescriptor.uvStrategy: planar UVs matched to baked tag-text texture

localFeatures: small folded triangular tab at top-left corner (zone-r1c0)

componentTree.name: '-24%' corner badge
componentTree.topologyRationale: Small flat card overlapping the tag's top-right corner.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: small rounded-corner plate, red, overlapping parent tag's corner
geometryDescriptor.uvStrategy: planar UVs matched to baked badge-text texture

materials.name: Phone anodized metal edge + back

albedo.samplingNotes: Near-black graphite, slight warm-neutral cast observed on the visible edge band.

surfaceFrequencyBands.role: brushed-metal directional streaking on edge band

roughness.localResponse: lower roughness on rounded edge highlight line

materials.notes: Back shell reuses this material as a plain flat region (occluded region, no independent evidence).

materials.name: Phone cover glass

albedo.samplingNotes: Glass base is near-black where content is dark; content layer supplies most visible color.

shaderNotes: Thin glossy coat over the emissive content layer; use clearcoat 1.0 low roughness.

materials.name: Projected UI content (screen)

albedo.samplingNotes: De-lit crop of the reference's own screen region (ZARA SALE card + bottom nav sheet), baked as a canvas/data texture, not a procedural redraw.

shaderNotes: Route: reference-projection. Source pixels de-lit and baked to a canvas texture at build time (see grimoire projection-first fidelity).
materials.notes: Rendered as an unlit/basic layer composited under the glass clearcoat so screen reads as self-illuminated.

materials.name: Hand skin

roughness.localResponse: lower roughness (~0.2) at knuckle specular hotspots
roughness.referencePbrNote: extract_pbr_evidence.py measured roughnessBase 0.69 on skin-crop.png; nudged initial estimate (0.5) up to 0.6, not fully to 0.69, since the crop includes a soft-shadow edge that inflates the estimate.

localOverrides.note: glossy specular highlight observed on knuckles (skin-oil sheen)

shaderNotes: Approximate subsurface look with a warm-tinted base + soft rim light rather than true SSS transmission (stylized real-time target).
materials.notes: analyze_texture.py's finish classifier (gem-metal|gemstone|painted-metal|worn-composite|brushed-steel|plastic) has no organic/skin category -- it forced this crop into 'painted-metal' with clearcoat=1.0 and a dark olive texturePalette pulled partly from background pixels at the crop edge. Overridden by direct visual analysis: baseColor/albedo/roughness/metalness above are the trusted values (see analysis.md Layer 5-6 and skin-crop.png). No clearcoat/transmission on skin.

materials.name: Handbag leather

albedo.samplingNotes: Warm beige/taupe, hue ~35-40deg, high value, low-moderate saturation.

roughness.referencePbrNote: extract_pbr_evidence.py measured roughnessBase 0.724 on leather-crop.png (flagged low-value-range, weakened inference); nudged initial estimate (0.55) up to 0.6.

materials.notes: Hardware omitted -- below legible resolution. analyze_texture.py's finish classifier has no leather/fabric category and forced this into 'brushed-steel' with metalness=1.0 and anisotropy -- reverted. Matte leather has metalness=0; roughness kept at the higher end (0.55) of the classifier's suggested band since the source reads more matte than the classifier's brushed-metal default (0.35) implied.

materials.name: Price tag card stock

albedo.samplingNotes: White card with black '$145' text block.

shaderNotes: '$145' text baked into an unlit canvas-texture overlay.

materials.name: -24% corner badge

albedo.samplingNotes: Vivid red, high saturation, high value; white '-24%' text.

shaderNotes: '-24%' text baked into an unlit canvas-texture overlay.

repetitionSystems.notes: Index/middle/ring fingers; each instance gets a slightly different curl angle and length so the row does not read as mechanically identical.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge phone+hand into one draw call region, drop bag/tag micro bevels

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: This is a small embedded product-card hero, not a hero cinematic -- keep triangle/draw-call budget low; finger repetition instanced.

proceduralStrategy: Block out phone slab, hand mass, bag prism, and tag plate first -- match silhouette and relative placement before any detail.
Add component hierarchy: screen/notch on phone; palm/thumb/fingers/forearm on hand; handle on bag; badge on tag.
Attach fingers to the phone's grip socket with wrap contactType so they read as gripping, not floating.
Solve camera framing and de-light + project the reference's own screen-region pixels onto the phone-screen component before treating the screen as 'done'.
Add material variation (skin knuckle sheen, leather grain) before micro-geometry polish.
Build the mall backdrop separately in the scene-assembly layer (not this spec's componentTree) as a soft blurred plane/gradient -- never claimed as reconstructed architecture.
animationAnchors: root pivot supports whole-scene camera framing
hand-fingers repetition instances support later per-finger curl animation
destructionAnchors: not applicable -- product-card hero asset, destructionPolicy.defaultBreakable=false across all components

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component is a stable named Object3D pivot with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
